Euromillions draw history

The Euromillions draw has a long and interesting history. First launched in February 2004, the Euromillions lottery is now one of the most popular lotteries in Europe. It is played in nine European countries and has created numerous millionaires. Every Tuesday and Friday night, millions of players across Europe take part in the Euromillions draw in the hope of becoming an instant millionaire. The game has an impressive jackpot reaching up to €240 million, making it one of the biggest lottery jackpots in Europe. Players can also win other great prizes, including holiday trips and cars. The Euromillions draw has a long history of producing many winners and dreams come true!

When is the EuroMillions draw in the United Kingdom?

The EuroMillions draw in the United Kingdom takes place every Tuesday and Friday evening. The draw starts at approximately 8:00 pm BST, with ticket sales closing just before the draw begins. Frequently Asked Questions

When is the EuroMillions draw in the United Kingdom?

What are the chances of winning the EuroMillions in the United Kingdom?

The chances of winning the EuroMillions in the United Kingdom are actually quite good. The UK is one of the top-performing countries in the EuroMillions, having won a total of 15 jackpot prizes since the game began in 2004. Each player in the UK has a 1 in 139 chance of winning the EuroMillions jackpot. However, there are other ways to win prizes, with odds varying depending on the number of correct numbers you select. It is also important to note that the EuroMillions rules stipulate that the winner must match all five main numbers as well as the two Lucky Star numbers in order to claim the full jackpot. Ultimately, while luck plays a large role, a good strategy can help improve your chances of success!
